Section 1 (R.C. 2923.111): "Qualifying adult" means a person who is all of the following: (a) Eighteen years of age or older; (b) Not legally prohibited from acquiring, possessing, or receiving a deadly weapon under law of this state or the United States;
Section 1 (R.C. 2923.111): (2) "Exclusive deadly weapon" means a deadly weapon that is an exclusive firearm or that is a deadly weapon that any law of this state or the United States prohibits the subject person from acquiring, possessing, having, or carrying.
